heroBody: The AirPods Pro 3 launched with the H3 chip, stronger active noise cancellation and heart-rate sensing. In the US, the cheapest AirPods Pro 3 listing usually comes from Amazon or a marketplace seller, but the safest deal is a Best Buy, Walmart, Target or B&H listing that ships with the full Apple one-year warranty. Listings also differ on the case variant — the MagSafe case and the USB-C case are priced separately at most US retailers — and the discount between them is small enough that the wrong case can quietly undo the saving. This page pulls live AirPods Pro 3 prices from BuyWhere's catalog every few minutes so you can see the current US floor and decide which listing is the right one to buy.

highlightSectionTitle: What to know before buying AirPods Pro 3 in the US

highlights.title: MagSafe vs USB-C case changes the price
highlights.body: US retailers list the AirPods Pro 3 with the MagSafe case and the plain USB-C case as separate SKUs. The MagSafe case adds a few dollars but supports Apple's MagSafe charger and precision Find My; the plain USB-C case is the better choice if you already own a MagSafe charger or do not use wireless charging on the go. The cheapest listing is sometimes the USB-C variant, so check before you click buy.

highlights.title: Warranty is real and worth keeping
highlights.body: A 'sold and shipped by Amazon' AirPods Pro 3 ships with a full one-year Apple US warranty and is eligible for AppleCare+. A 'fulfilled by Amazon' listing from a third-party seller generally keeps the Apple warranty only if Apple itself is the shipper; otherwise the warranty reverts to the seller. The cheapest marketplace listing can cost you Apple Care eligibility, so factor that in.

highlights.title: Apple Card financing can flip the deal
highlights.body: Buying direct from Apple with an Apple Card unlocks 0% monthly financing for 12 months on AirPods Pro 3 and occasional 3% Daily Cash. If you would otherwise put the purchase on a credit card, the Apple financing path can beat the cheapest third-party sticker once you include the cashback. The savings are not always reflected in the headline price.

adviceSectionTitle: How to pay the least for AirPods Pro 3 in the US without losing the warranty
advicePoints: Decide on case variant first: MagSafe or plain USB-C. The cheapest AirPods Pro 3 listing is often the USB-C version, so do not pay MagSafe money for a plain listing.
Prefer 'sold and shipped by Amazon' or in-store pickup at Best Buy, Walmart or Target over an unbranded marketplace seller. You keep the full one-year Apple warranty and AppleCare+ eligibility.
Compare with B&H and Adorama if you live outside New York or New Jersey — they usually do not collect sales tax, which often beats a small Amazon discount.
Time the purchase to a back-to-school or Black Friday window if you can wait. Apple typically discounts AirPods Pro 3 by a modest amount during the September event and again for the holidays.

If you already own the AirPods Pro 2 and you mostly use them at a desk, the upgrade is hard to justify. The Pro 2 is on clearance at Walmart and Amazon for noticeably less, and it is still an excellent earbud.
Avoid listings priced well below the market floor without reviews — they are usually refurbished, opened-box, or bait-and-switch to a different listing on landing.
faqSectionTitle: AirPods Pro 3 in the US — common questions

faqs.question: Which AirPods Pro 3 case should I buy in the US?
faqs.answer: Buy the MagSafe case if you use Apple's MagSafe charger or want precision Find My on the case. Buy the plain USB-C case if you already own a MagSafe charger or do not care about wireless charging — it is usually a few dollars cheaper.

faqs.question: Do US marketplace AirPods Pro 3 come with Apple warranty?
faqs.answer: Yes when the listing is 'sold and shipped by Amazon' or 'shipped from Apple'. A 'fulfilled by Amazon' third-party seller can still ship with Apple warranty if the seller buys from Apple authorised channels, but you should confirm this in the listing. Otherwise, warranty reverts to the seller and AppleCare+ is unavailable.

faqs.question: When is the AirPods Pro 3 cheapest in the US?
faqs.answer: Historically during the Apple back-to-school and Black Friday windows in late August through November. Outside those sales, live prices on this page show the current US floor.

faqs.question: Can I use AirPods Pro 3 with Android in the US?
faqs.answer: Yes for audio and basic noise cancellation. Adaptive audio, hearing features, heart-rate sensing and seamless switching rely on an iPhone, so Android users get less value for the money and a discounted AirPods Pro 2 is usually a smarter pick.

categoryIntro.heading: Why US AirPods Pro 3 prices vary by case and seller
categoryIntro.body: US AirPods Pro 3 pricing is shaped by Apple Store list pricing, Amazon's price-match culture and the case variant the buyer actually wants. Apple sells both the MagSafe and USB-C variants at fixed prices, while Best Buy, Walmart, Target and B&H tend to alternate who holds the lowest in-stock price month to month. Amazon is usually the floor on launch day and during major promotions, but marketplace sellers can undercut everyone on a quiet Tuesday and then quietly revert. This page reads live US AirPods Pro 3 listings so you can see the current lowest in-stock price and decide whether the case, warranty and shipping time are worth the saving.
